id.description: The unique identifier for the data source.

name.description: The name of the data source.

description.description: A description of the data source.

contentUrl.description: The URL name of the data source.

type.description: The type of data source (e.g., sqlserver, postgres, excel, hyper, etc.).

createdAt.description: The date and time the data source was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the data source was last updated.

isCertified.description: Whether the data source is certified.

certificationNote.description: The certification note for the data source.

useRemoteQueryAgent.description: Whether the data source uses a remote query agent.

hasExtracts.description: Whether the data source has extracts.

encryptExtracts.description: Whether the data source extracts are encrypted.
